title: STARTEX: Ghost Pressure — SCADA vs. Field Gauges & Life Safety

fields.location: Corwin Valley Gas Company Gas Control Room, Level 2, Room 140
fields.staffing: Full shift: VP, GCM, CYB, FOS, SEC, PIO, M&R technicians, Gas Control operators
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is a tabletop exercise. It is 16:30 on Wednesday, January 13, 2027. The gas system is operating normally. All control room and field units report nominal status. The narrative clock begins.

status.name: SCADA System
status.note: All HMI screens show nominal pressure, flow, and valve status

status.name: Pressure District 7 (RS-21, RS-22)
status.note: Regulator setpoints PC-21 and PC-22 nominal; telemetry stable

status.name: Pressure District 8 (RS-23, RS-24)
status.note: Mechanical pilots only; field checks every 30 minutes

status.name: Field Gauges (PR-7A, PR-7B)
status.note: Last readings received 16:25: 14.2 in. w.c. (within max limit)

status.name: Gas Control Room (CVG-HMI01–03)
status.note: All consoles active; no alarms triggered

status.name: OT Network (CVGOT)
status.note: No unauthorized access detected; CVG-OT-JMP01 in normal state

status.name: Field Operations (M&R)
status.note: Two crews on patrol; M&R techs at RS-21 and RS-22 report no anomalies

fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm all roles have the exercise briefing packet and ICS 201 forms. No one has seen the hidden threat yet. Begin with full normalcy.
fields.scenarioTitle: Ghost Pressure — SCADA vs. Field Gauges & Life Safety

instructorNote: This inject establishes baseline normalcy. The players will not yet suspect SCADA is compromised. Watch for overconfidence in SCADA data and delayed recognition of field discrepancies.
